Europe/Athens is UTC+2 in summer (EEST).  
Europe/Paris is UTC+2 in summer (CEST) at that date (both on DST-like adjustments historically, but for 1211 likely mean solar time differences).  
Historical time zone differences before standardization are not defined; treat as same local solar time for this problem unless specified otherwise.  
Thus 4 AM in Athens = 4 AM in Paris on same date.  

FINAL_ANSWER: August 6, 1211 04:00
